content.comment_body: Phase-out notice for AS-i accessories and modules. The affected products include: - K45 modules with M8 snap-on connectors - F90 modules with 16 inputs - Printed circuit board modules with IP00 protection rating - AS-i module for [product_name] - Addressing accessories - Flat cable adapter with PG thread - K60 DC starter

analysis.insight_summary: The user shares information about the discontinuation of several AS-i accessories and modules, mentioning specifically an AS-i module related to [product_name]. They express concern about future availability, potential gaps in supply, and support for these items. The message is informative and suggests ongoing projects may be impacted by the phase-out.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for continued availability or advance notice before withdrawal of important module accessories, and seeks guidance or support regarding alternatives and maintaining existing installations.
